title: Unmasking the LLM: How Attention Works
description: Ever wondered how AI understands context? Dive into the 'Attention' mechanism that powers ChatGPT. An interactive visualization of how words connect.

stages.title: The Context Problem
stages.text: Before Transformers, AI struggled with long sentences. 'Attention' changed everything by allowing AI to focus on specific words regardless of distance.

stages.title: Mapping the Connections
stages.text: The glowing lines show the 'Attention Weights'. Words aren't just strings; they are interconnected nodes in a high-dimensional space.
stages.interaction: Move your mouse to reveal the focus weights of each token.

stages.title: The Magic of eduNest
stages.text: At eduNest, we turn complex AI concepts into interactive experiences. Join us to master the technology of tomorrow.

parent_guidance: Encourage your child to think about how they pay attention to specific words in a sentence like 'The cat sat on the mat'. Which word is the most important?
